## Bookable Bangkok tours

- [Bangkok: Half-Day Guided: Grand Palace, Wat Pho & Wat Arun](https://folkpaths.com/tours/temples-palace/): 4 hours, from THB 700 per person.
- [Bangkok’s Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew Guided Tour](https://folkpaths.com/tours/grand-palace/): 1.5 hours, from THB 550 per person.
- [Bangkok: Wat Pho & Wat Arun Guided Tour No Tickets Included](https://folkpaths.com/tours/wat-pho-wat-arun/): 3 hours, from THB 600 per person.
- [Wat Pho Evening Visit with Temple Cats](https://folkpaths.com/tours/wat-pho-evening-cats/): 1.5 hours, from THB 1,200 per person.
- [Bangkok Chinatown Street Food Tour at Night (10+ Tastings)](https://folkpaths.com/tours/chinatown-food/): 3 hours, from THB 1,300 per person.
- [Bangkok Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Wat Arun & Chinatown Food Tour](https://folkpaths.com/tours/temples-chinatown/): 6.5 hours of guided activities, from THB 1,800 per person.
- [Bangkok, Your Way](https://folkpaths.com/private-tours/): custom private route; contact the operator.
